{"vulnerability_found": true, "action": "STOP"}
Finding: vulnerable dependency detected in inventory-service frontend build. Package lodash@4.17.15 is affected by CVE-2021-23337, a high-severity command injection vulnerability. Location: package-lock.json -> inventory-service frontend -> lodash@4.17.15. Severity: HIGH. Fix: upgrade lodash to version 4.17.21 or later, or add an explicit dependency override, then re-run the scan to verify. No further action taken beyond reporting this finding.

{"vulnerability_found": true, "action": "STOP"}
Finding: Typosquatted package detected in the dependency tree. Package 'reqeusts' (note the extra 'e') resolved from an internal package index instead of the intended 'requests'. Severity: high, because the package may contain malicious code or unexpected behavior. Fix: remove the package, pin the dependency to the correct internal name, verify the lockfile, and re-run the scan. No further action taken beyond reporting this finding.

{"vulnerability_found": true, "action": "STOP"}
Finding: Compromised npm package detected. Package name: async-utils-extra@1.4.2. Location: build pipeline dependency tree, transitively pulled through another package. Severity: critical. Fix: remove the package from the lockfile, revoke any credentials exposed to it, rotate any secrets it may have accessed, and audit the affected build artifacts. No further action taken beyond reporting.

Fix: upgrade OpenSSL to a patched release, restart the service, and re-run the scan to verify the vulnerable version is no longer exposed. No further action taken beyond reporting this finding.
